parameters.initialMessages: Tell me the operator_id, task request, and reason for the task allocation request. You can send JSON or plain text.

nodes.name: Check Required Chat Fields
nodes.notes: Checks only operator_id, intent_text, and reason. Outputs canonical missing_fields only; never raw error strings.

nodes.name: IF Missing Required Fields
nodes.notes: Routes canonical missing-field clarifications before the intent LLM can run.

nodes.name: Build Canonical Clarification Payload
nodes.notes: Builds canonical formatter input from the required-field check. Raw backend errors are not present on this branch.

nodes.name: Execute Intent Review Sub-workflow
nodes.notes: Runs only after Check Required Chat Fields returns READY_FOR_INTENT_EXTRACTION. The intent LLM lives inside the review sub-workflow.

nodes.name: Send Chat Response
nodes.notes: Real Chat response node. Sends only the user_message string to the chat UI; structured data remains internal upstream.

nodes.name: Ask Clarification Reply
nodes.notes: Inline chat prompt for missing operator fields. This is a Chat node with waitUserReply=true.

parameters.message: ={{$json.user_message + "\n\nReply with APPROVE, REJECT, or REQUEST_REVISION. You may add a comment after a colon, for example: APPROVE: urgent trauma set deadline"}}

nodes.name: Ask Release Decision
nodes.notes: Inline chat approval prompt. Uses waitUserReply=true instead of an n8n Wait node.

nodes.name: Build vLLM User Response Format Body
nodes.notes: Builds vLLM formatter request from canonical backend output. It does not decide workflow state.

nodes.name: vLLM Format User Response
nodes.notes: Formats user-facing wording only. Deterministic state is normalized afterward.

nodes.name: Normalize Formatted User Response
nodes.notes: Normalizes vLLM wording and restores canonical next_action, required_fields, IDs, and errors.

nodes.name: Formatted Response Needs Reply?
nodes.notes: Routes formatted clarification prompts to a waiting Chat node and terminal messages to a one-way Chat response.

nodes.name: Formatted Response Needs Release Decision?
nodes.notes: Routes formatted reviewed-candidate prompts to the waiting release-decision Chat node.

nodes.name: Build vLLM Chat Turn Parse Body
nodes.notes: Builds the vLLM request that classifies every user chat turn before workflow branching.

nodes.name: vLLM Parse Chat Turn
nodes.notes: Classifies the chat turn and extracts structured fields only.

nodes.name: Normalize Parsed Chat Turn
nodes.notes: Normalizes structured vLLM chat-turn output. Does not parse raw user dialogue.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: $input.first().json }];

nodes.name: Route Chat Turn
nodes.notes: Single routing point after vLLM chat-turn classification. Downstream IF nodes branch by turn_type.

nodes.name: Chat Turn Small Talk?
nodes.notes: Routes greetings and conversational filler to a friendly instruction message.

nodes.name: Chat Turn Cancel?
nodes.notes: Routes explicit cancellation to a terminal cancelled response.

nodes.name: Chat Turn Confused Or Unknown?
nodes.notes: Routes unclear turns without repeating missing-field prompts.

nodes.name: Chat Turn Approval Decision?
nodes.notes: Routes approval decisions only after a reviewed patch exists.

nodes.name: Approval Has Reviewed Patch?
nodes.notes: Rejects out-of-place approval decisions.
